description: Where a trading vault’s or trader’s result came from: trading (closed trades and the change in open positions), funding, fees and the residual nothing explains, per vault and summed, only over days whose every term was read (the rest counted with their reason). FREE for one vault or trader over 30 days; longer history and the day-by-day series are paid.
